data.subject: Re: Staffing model draft
data.body:
Hi Dana,

On Sept 4 you said you’d “send me the staffing model draft by the 15th so I can fold it into the ops review.”

We later agreed to move the deadline to the 29th.

Just checking in to see if you’d like any help getting the draft ready—happy to jump on a quick call or review whatever you have so far.

Let me know what works best for you.

Thanks,

Sam
